read: Run freshness check first; STALE/error -> reread current source/tests.
routes -> selected modules -> source/tests; detail only for edges/flows/API/storage/evidence.
Paths are repo-relative. Static discovery aid, not live status/acceptance or a complete call graph.
runtime: Windows; Python3.14/FastAPI/Uvicorn/SQLite/pywin32; static JS; localhost only; 1 active run; no queue/auto-resend.

entrypoints.diagnose.py: explicit models query; no inference prompt
entrypoints.agweb/validation.py: python -m agweb.validation; live run requires separate approval/budget

startup.owns: Launch/shutdown; single-instance mutex; localhost port/token/runtime.json; Uvicorn.

config.owns: APP_ROOT vs Config.root/data; CLI path/env overrides; timeouts/hash.

api.owns: FastAPI auth/Host/Origin/size boundary; REST; send gates; downloads/Explorer.

store.owns: Sole SQLite writer; migrations/revision/idempotent reservation/events; attachments/instructions/delete recovery/output metadata.

controller.owns: Workspace/hooks/AGENTS sync; output instructions; supervisor IPC; delta persistence batched at 75ms / 8KiB, flush before other events.

supervisor.owns: Own CLI Job; correlate Hook/stdout; enforce deadlines/heartbeat/limits; stop/validate output/emit terminal.

hook.owns: PreInvocation/PreToolUse relay via authenticated AF_PIPE; return decision/argument replacement.

policy.owns: Strict known tool/argument allowlist; scoped one-shot write_to_file.

output.owns: Registered folder/name/link checks; collision suffix; nonempty UTF-8 <=1MiB; file size/hash/state.

windows.owns: Mutex/JobProcess; create suspended -> assign Job -> resume; handle allowlist; kill/active count.

gate.owns: Fingerprint source/UI/runtime/config/global instructions/rules/skills/plugins; prefer local consent without legacy fallback; preserve legacy acceptance modes. Fresh before sends; cached on status polls.

diagnostics.owns: Explicit model-list query in bounded Job; cache/diagnostic report; no inference prompt.

quota.owns: Verify local consent or legacy config; dedicated explicitly trusted local-setup cwd; parse recognized usage fields.

validation.owns: Explicit live-test authorization/consume-before-launch ledger/receipts/finalize; separate from normal sends.

reading_export.owns: Shared Markdown sanitization + standalone reading HTML; bundled Marked/DOMPurify.

llama_converter.owns: Offline llama.app JSONL current-branch parse -> preview/download HTML; no server/model.

mock.owns: CLI/usage substitutes; Hook ordering/output/fault/stop scenarios; no real model.

browser_harness.owns: Node DOM/API/clipboard harness; distinct from real browser acceptance.

onboarding.owns: Per-install configuration review/connection check/human consent; never live acceptance; committed allowlist ZIP build.
onboarding.process: server / explicit setup or build command

constraints: DB is canonical; only server writes SQLite; instructions -> per-conversation AGENTS.md on save/prelaunch.
First reservation freezes model/effort/instructions/output_mode; revision detects conflicts; request_id prevents duplicate launch.
text_file: one validated write_to_file/auto_approve; no overwrite/edit/delete/exec/local reads; external txt survives conversation deletion.
File success requires process cleanup + actual UTF-8/size/hash validation; never trust SUCCESS text alone.
File body excluded from chat/events/DB answer/search/reading exports; instructions excluded from reading exports.
API Bearer != X-Run-Owner; history replay/reload never sends; unconfirmed Job cleanup retains lock.

Current owner's live HTTP stream renews browser lease; keepalive not persisted; observer/rotated owner cannot renew. Heartbeat and disconnect timeout remain. UI delta rendering throttled at 100ms (tests/test_long_generation.cjs).
Normal-mode write_to_file -> output_mode_mismatch; local Job stop != cloud cancellation; logical send != internal model-call count.
Index freshness != runtime gate fingerprint/acceptance/live-test authorization.
